title: In This Town Everything You Lose Finds Its Way BACK
description:
In my town, nothing stays lost. Gloves hop after their owners up the slipway, and a dog that slips its lead rides the ferry home on its own.

Nothing I lose ever comes back. Then every street I took started ending at the slipway, and a line of damp little dots began at my own front door.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: What would you want to find its way back to you?
